learning_signal: On org/reliability guarantee signatures the routed leverage pass plus structure-first scan (S1) converts the leverage style's first-sight loop mapping into a mandatory deliverable: map the governing loops before arithmetic, position every candidate on the leverage scale (parameters < delays < negative-feedback strength < information flows < rules < goals), and give each ranked point a falsifiable observable so misidentification is caught by the verification metric itself.
suggested_improvement: Keep the m040-first-class route on guarantee signatures (top3 m040/m031/m070); make the per-point falsifiable-observable a standing m040 contract item; keep the P8 closed-scope fast path on fully-specified recommendation briefs to trim the packet overhead that cost the efficiency dimension.

key_gap: vs baseline: the pure style misidentified leverage (its registry weakness) — it ranked a $500k/6-month goals/KPI program above the observed cause (checkout regression from the API upgrade; 1 engineer-hour fix restoring ~$1.2M/month) and dismissed the deployment-window correlation without opening the funnel or deploy data. The v6 router sent no structural-lever style on this adversarial/deadline/unmeasured signature; the m019 adversary pass (baseline-risk comparison attacking the program's unfalsifiable assumptions), the m006 provenance audit (likelihood scenarios showing the deployment hypothesis dominates any honest posterior), and m021 tempo (commit at DO under $40k/day cost-of-delay) caught the trap before ranking. Residual: the leverage-misidentification check is gate-borne rather than module-borne — m040 itself was not routed, so the trap is only closed when the gates fire.
learning_signal: Leverage is defined by change per effort along the observed causal chain, not structural depth: on decide/diagnose signatures with adversarial, deadline, or unmeasured context, route adversary + tempo + provenance (m019/m021/m006) instead of any structural-lever style; an unfalsifiable 'deep' story with no onset-window tie must lose to the cheapest candidate that fully explains the windowed data.
suggested_improvement: Formalize a leverage-misidentification screen as a standing gate wherever a 'deep lever vs direct fix' framing appears: per-candidate falsifiable observable, onset-window tie, and baseline-risk comparison against the cheapest full-explanation candidate; keep m040 out of signatures containing adversarial/deadline/unmeasured triggers (already reflected in the router) and re-verify on this case's regression re-run.
